Voices of the Hazlehurst Animal Shelter (VHAS) is a small but dedicated group of volunteers focused on caring for shelter dogs and those in the area community of Hazlehurst,Georgia. We appreciate your kindness in checking out our dogs and helping us  continue saving lives.

Videos are primarily to help potential rescues to get to know our current dogs. 

Additional information on dogs featured and whether they are or are not still be available for adoption or rescue, inquires can be made on our Facebook page. Adoption application is required for all adoptions. Send an email to VHAS.ga@gmail.com for all inquiries
